verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents built-in AI agents. You brief an agent in plain language, choose which apps, flows and files it can use, and it decides the steps and carries out the work as it arrives, with optional approval gates. You can also describe an agent in chat and have it drafted for you. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks run reliably, and detail on whether the in-product chat assistant itself executes ad-hoc tasks rather than only drafting agents and automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: You write down the job in plain language, give it access to the apps it needs, and it handles the work as it arrives.
You set the goal and choose which apps, flows and files the agent can use. It decides the steps and carries them out. Anything you want to check first waits for your approval.
Describe what you want in chat, and Activepieces builds the agent or automation for you.
Write "summarise my unread emails every morning" and you get a drafted agent — a name, instructions, and the tools it needs
